product: G-AID ERT 1.0 historical Gaussian-kernel invert (not the live engine)

cases.name: homogeneous_100ohm_5pct_noise
cases.recovery_claim: Median model resistivity within 15% of the true homogeneous value under 5% noise.
cases.forward: ρa = ρtrue (homogeneous half-space), independent of the invert Jacobian construction except through invert_2d_smooth itself

cases.name: two_layer_wenner_50_over_500
cases.forward: Wenner two-layer image series (Telford 1990 §8.4), independent of the invert kernel
cases.recovery_claim: 1-D layering is not recovered by this homogeneous-half-space smoothness invert. Observed shallow/deep medians are recorded so the limitation is test-backed.
not_claimed: Groundwater, lithology, ore, or drill targets

cases.name: lateral_contrast_left_conductive
cases.forward: Independent 1-D Wenner image series on the left; homogeneous 200 Ω·m on the right
cases.recovery_claim: Lateral contrast is recorded, not required. If left_shallow < right_shallow, the invert shows a qualitative left-side low; otherwise the kernel does not resolve this contrast.
cases.not_claimed: Contact position, true resistivities, 3-D structure, groundwater.
